title: Scanner reasoning inventory and upstream authority consolidation

checks.name: all-scanner-typescript-files-accounted-for
checks.detail: 488 TS/TSX files have an inventory record.

checks.name: constraint-calculus-scanner-path-is-facade
checks.detail: Scanner compatibility module contains exports only, not constraint reasoning or solver orchestration.

checks.name: relational-reasoning-cluster-is-upstream-owned
checks.detail: Six scanner entrypoints are compatibility facades; relation program validation, theory, catalog, kernel, closure, and constraint calculus implementations live upstream.

checks.name: upstream-semantic-owners-do-not-import-scanner
checks.detail: The moved upstream semantic owners do not depend back on scanner implementation modules.

checks.name: constraint-authority-uses-foundation-solver
checks.detail: Constraint filtering and iterative closure live in upstream authority and reuse the foundation solver.

checks.name: executor-delegates-to-authority
checks.detail: Runtime executor delegates constraint and generic relation execution to one injected authority.

checks.name: behavior-kernel-does-not-call-solver-directly
checks.detail: Scanner behavior-kernel facade no longer owns generic relation closure.

checks.name: resource-mapping-consumers-use-runtime-interface
checks.detail: Resource mapping consumers use the canonical upstream runtime binding, do not instantiate per-consumer executors, and do not invoke the solver directly.

checks.name: inventory-explicitly-preserves-unmigrated-frontiers
checks.detail: The report does not claim the entire scanner has been purged of semantic reasoning.
